cases.request: In Formly 6.3.12, how do I write a simple custom text input template and connect it to the Formly control?
answer_checks: Explain FieldType<FieldTypeConfig>, [formControl] and [formlyAttributes].
Do not claim this implements any arbitrary custom-widget value accessor.

cases.request: What does [formlyAttributes] do on my custom Formly input? Is it the same thing as [formControl]?
answer_checks: Distinguish DOM attributes/events from the control binding.

cases.request: For an NgModule-based Formly 6.3.12 custom input, what belongs in declarations and imports, and where is the type alias registered?
answer_checks: Mention declaration, reactive-forms/template imports and types registration separately.
Label the pinned example Bootstrap-specific rather than prescribing Bootstrap for every adapter.

cases.request: My custom Formly type represents one FormControl, but another represents a FormGroup. Which FieldType configuration interfaces fit those controls?
answer_checks: Name FieldTypeConfig and FieldGroupTypeConfig correctly.
Typing does not create or convert runtime controls.

cases.request: Can I pass my component class directly as a Formly field type, or must I always register a string name? What changes if my fields come from JSON?
answer_checks: Explain both routes and JSON limitation.
Do not confuse a selector string with a registered Formly name.

cases.request: What do FormlyModule.forRoot and forChild contribute for custom type configuration in v6.3.12?
answer_checks: State the shared config contribution and forRoot FormlyConfig provider.
Do not infer universal lazy injector visibility from those declarations.

cases.request: What does FormlyConfig.getType do when my string type name is not registered, with and without throwIfNotFound?
answer_checks: Distinguish null by default from the requested thrown error.

cases.request: At the type-wrapper fallback step, does wrappers: [] take the registered wrappers, or prevent that fallback?
answer_checks: Empty array is truthy and skips this fallback.
Keep the statement scoped to that merge step; do not promise no extension can add wrappers.

cases.request: In Formly Material 6.3.12, what base class and bindings does the built-in input use, and where does its form-field wrapper come from?
answer_checks: Identify Material FieldType import, matInput, bindings and registered wrapper.

cases.request: Can I import TypeOption from @ngx-formly/core 6.3.12 to type my custom registration array? If not, what public type can I derive it from?
answer_checks: No public TypeOption export; derive element type from ConfigOption types.
No deep import recommendation.
